name: Anatomic
all_locations: Gurugram, HR, India; Noida, UP, India
long_description: Anatomic works with hospitals and doctors to collect surgical video, doctor-patient conversations and medical imaging for AI and robotics research. Our data library includes multi-perspective surgical recordings, diarized and transcribed clinical conversations, and annotated X-ray, CT and MRI series linked to longitudinal patient records. Built through a network of 100+ hospitals and 1,000+ clinicians, with HIPAA- and GDPR-compliant data.
one_liner: Real-world healthcare data for medical AI
